description: terremotos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cabildo Insular de La Palma. Earthquakes of the last days in the area of La Palma of magnitude equal to or greater than 1.5 or senses. Information on earthquakes of lower magnitude can be obtained in earthquake catalogue. This information is subject to change as a result of the continuous review of the seismic analysis.Source: National Geographic Institute. Coverage: Cabildo Insular de La Palma. The portal shows the English title as "earthquakes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cabildo Insular de La Palma. Its keywords include tectonicas, suelo, movimientos sismicos, ods11, placas, medio-ambiente. The listing shows 2017-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.opendatalapalma.es/pages/avisolegal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
